column8: ["The two upper seats are filled with domed teal forms that read as atoms; paint empty, broad circular sockets with unobstructed interiors.","The lower orange seat reads as a tilted cup with a visible inner wall; redraw its opening as concentric shapes seen straight down.","Bright upper-left highlights and dark lower-right shading on the teal forms impose directional lighting; use symmetric tonal structure under even diffuse light.","The orange seat is at the bottom instead of the scaffold’s upper-left mark; restore the orange upper-left and teal lower seat arrangement."]
